decision_input_coverage.note: Coverage of the selected model's declared inputs, not a probability of valuation accuracy or investment success. Standard policy assumptions are assumptions, not analyst approval or observed accounting facts. Optional operating-DCF, TTM, relative-multiple and research inputs do not lower this coverage. Critical gaps cap the headline evidence score below the selection threshold.

debt_to_equity.label: Debt / equity
debt_to_equity.note: Computed from latest balance sheet debt and shareholder equity.

eps_growth.label: Annual diluted EPS growth
eps_growth.note: Computed from latest and prior annual diluted EPS.

gross_margin.label: Gross margin
gross_margin.note: Computed from latest annual gross profit and revenue.

net_margin.label: Reported net margin
net_margin.note: Computed from latest annual net income and revenue.

pe_ratio.label: Trailing P/E
pe_ratio.note: Latest close divided by available trailing twelve-month EPS on verified currency and quoted-share units.

peg_ratio.label: Historical-growth PEG
peg_ratio.note: PEG is not meaningful when EPS growth is below 2.5%.

revenue_growth.label: Annual revenue growth
revenue_growth.note: Computed from latest and prior annual total revenue.

roe.label: Return on ending equity
roe.note: Computed from annual net income divided by ending shareholder equity.

roic.label: Return on invested capital
roic.note: A current sourced annual operating-capital record is required.

price_to_annual_diluted_eps.note: A dated price divided by the last fiscal year's diluted EPS, not current TTM P/E or an estimate of fair value. Matching currency and quoted-share basis are required.

policy.calibration: fixed uncalibrated research heuristics; no outcome fit or default-probability interpretation
policy.incomplete_policy: withhold composite; never drop an applicable component, assign missing zero, choose an older complete period, or redistribute weights
policy.price_basis: all observations require provider-adjusted close; no raw-close or beta fallback

policy.score_direction: higher means a less favorable observed characteristic

Fixed uncalibrated research heuristics, not a probability of loss/default, regulatory assessment or permission to invest. Categories have different policies and scores are not empirically calibrated across categories.
The indicator does not establish debt maturities, covenant headroom, finance-lease scope, earnings quality or liquidity adequacy.

Statement ratios use the latest sourced fiscal year and ending assets; price variability uses a separately dated market window. These periods are explicit, not represented as a common-date risk measurement.
Composite withheld: required components unavailable: price_variability, parent_book_capital, reported_profitability, operating_cash_generation. Available components retain their fixed weights.

assumptions: Relative prices are displayed separately and never averaged into this equity distribution estimate.

policy.growth_source: aligned three-year revenue CAGR; no buyback-driven EPS growth extrapolation
policy.marginal_roe_fade: linear to cost of equity by year five; each distribution funds next-year growth
policy.model_selection: fixed by business type, never by which model gives a higher value
policy.normalization: min(latest signed annual diluted EPS, arithmetic mean of latest three)
policy.not_calibrated_to: market prices, selection counts, historical returns or probability of profit
policy.valuation_scope: common-equity going-concern distribution scenario; no separate asset liquidation credit
